target_semantics_lesson: Focus on the acceleration of year-over-year revenue growth, not the growth rate itself. This means assessing the change in the growth rate from the prior period.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by ensuring current, cutoff-safe evidence supports every retained outgoing relationship and intermediate link.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Economic factors like inflation and consumer spending drive revenue growth acceleration. Test competing paths by comparing current evidence for each, prioritizing stronger mechanisms.
counterevidence_lesson: Acknowledge counterevidence, such as positive earnings beats. Assess if it dominates or reverses the leading supported path by comparing current evidence.
calibration_lesson: Reduce confidence when causal links are weak, contradicted, or unknown. Uncertainty in magnitude and boundary crossing requires careful calibration.
